comments.mergedPostDetails: We need this! This would give us the ability to quickly find world that we enjoy, even if the name of the world is changed. It will be quickly accessable.

comments.value: I'm glad to hear this will probably be implemented in the next update. It's been a long time coming, and many new, and old users of VRChat will be happy with this news.
I can't wait until there is favorite maps.
Its so annoying not having favorite worlds. This should have been done so long ago.
I shouldn't complain its a free awesome game. thanks for putting it in progress.

details: As an additional bar for the worlds menu. So you can easily go to worlds you like.
title: Add worlds to your favourites
